from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyRegionRecord(BaseModel):
    """One row of monthly housing starts data extracted from a report table."""
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="Date the press release was issued (YYYY-MM-DD); used for precedence of conflicting data")
    data_month: str = Field(description="The calendar month the data corresponds to (YYYY-MM)")
    region: str = Field(description="The region name or 'United States' for the total (e.g. 'Northeast', 'South')")
    units_started: float = Field(description="Number of housing units started (in thousands)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for extracted housing start data from a single document."""
    records: list[MonthlyRegionRecord]
